anomalies.observed: In the 'Capacitive Touch Button (TSC)' block (root sheet page 1, and confirmed in the right-hand tile page 2), the bottom plate of C14 (22 n), the left terminal of R8 (1 k), the A2 'BTN' electrode, and BOTH hierarchical labels TSC_G2_IO2 and TSC_G2_IO4 all terminate on a single node. The two stacked labels TSC_G2_IO4 and TSC_G2_IO2 both feed the left side of R8, and C14's return wire joins that same line.
anomalies.expected: Per the specification these are two distinct TSC nets: 'TSC_G2_IO2: U2 pin 57 (PB5) — R8 (1 kΩ series resistor) — A2 pin BTN' and 'TSC_G2_IO4: U2 pin 59 (PB7) — C14 (22 nF to GND)'. The sampling capacitor must hang only on TSC_G2_IO4 (PB7) to GND, and the series resistor/electrode only on TSC_G2_IO2 (PB5); the two nets must not be connected.

evidence.quote: TSC box: GND -> C14 22n -> node that carries labels TSC_G2_IO4 and TSC_G2_IO2 and R8 1k -> A2 BTN (page 1 / page 2 tile)
TSC_G2_IO2: U2 pin 57 (PB5) — R8 (1 kΩ series resistor) — A2 pin "BTN" ... TSC_G2_IO4: U2 pin 59 (PB7) — C14 (22 nF to GND) — this is the TSC sampling capacitor for the group

anomalies.impact: PB5 and PB7 are shorted together and the 22 nF sampling capacitor is placed in parallel with the electrode series-resistor path. The STM32 Touch Sensing Controller group-2 charge/discharge measurement is corrupted (sampling cap on the wrong node, two group pins driven together), so the capacitive touch button will not function correctly.

parsed.summary: The NFC, display, SWD and power sections match the specification, but the capacitive-touch block merges the TSC_G2_IO2 and TSC_G2_IO4 nets (C14, R8, the electrode and both MCU pins on one node), contradicting the spec's separate sampling-capacitor and series-resistor paths.
